ἐκλογ-ισμός , ὁ,
A.keeping of accounts, in pl., Inscr.Prien. 108.214
(ii B.C.), Phalar. Ep. 24 ; computation, calculation, Haussoullier Cinquantenaire de l'école des hautes études
p.88 (Didyma, ii B.C.), Plu. Cat.Mi. 36 ; consideration, reckoning, in pl., Plb. 1.59.2 , D.H. Th. 3 , Plu. Oth. 9 (v.l.), etc.; setting out of grammatical paradigms,
D.T. 629.8 ; conclusion of an argument, Hp. Nat.Puer. 12 .
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
